risks: The dataset's existence, live URL, discussion announcement, and exact two-file contents are not confirmed by any page read.
The service check found no real-work commits in the checked repository in the last 30 days, which follows from its FACT claim and weakens confidence that prior publishing work shipped.
Dataset-card metadata such as license is not shown for this dataset, so licensing and reuse terms remain unknown.
The pages describe general Hugging Face upload steps only; they do not verify that this specific upload succeeded.

A dataset discussion announcement linking that live URL would confirm the announcement step.
The dataset card and data rows themselves would allow assessing the 4-byte alignment content directly.
